summary.en: Kubernetes command-line tool. The winget manifest lists a Windows arm64 kubectl.exe.
summary.zh-TW: Kubernetes 命令列工具，winget 清單提供 Windows arm64 版 kubectl.exe。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
